seoTitle: Columbus City Schools Calendar 2027–28: Key Dates & PDFs
seoDescription: Columbus City Schools grades 1–12 start Aug. 19, 2027. See kindergarten and Pre-K dates, Wellness Week, breaks, Woodcrest intersessions, PDFs, and an .ics download.
heroSummary: On the CCS traditional calendar, students in grades 1–12 start Thursday, August 19, 2027. Kindergarten starts Tuesday, August 24, and Pre-K starts Tuesday, September 7. The last day for traditional-calendar students is Thursday, May 25, 2028. Woodcrest follows a separate year-round calendar, with grades 1–5 starting July 22 and the school year ending May 31.
heroSourceLine: 2027–28 calendar dates · Verified against official CCS calendar sources
calendarNotes: The default event list follows the traditional calendar, while Woodcrest's July-start calendar is linked as a separate attendance track. Grades 1-12 begin August 19, kindergarten begins August 24, and Pre-K begins September 7, so families must use the program-specific first day. November 22-26 is a five-weekday Wellness Week closure, with November 24 designated as the compensatory day for parent conferences. December 17 and April 13 are 30-minute early dismissals for traditional K-12 students, but Pre-K is closed for professional development on December 17. Professional-development and records days explicitly marked “students not in attendance” are included as student closures. Woodcrest begins grades 1-5 on July 22, adds kindergarten and Pre-K on July 27, and places intersessions in fall, January, and April. CCS warns that severe weather, energy problems, or another public calamity can revise the calendar, so families should recheck the live district and school calendars.

customSections.label: Which CCS Calendar Applies in 2027–28?
customSections.content: For 2027–28, CCS currently publishes a Traditional Calendar and a Woodcrest Year-Round Calendar. Pre-K start dates and several no-Pre-K dates appear on those PDFs, but CCS has not posted separate 2027–28 Pre-K PDFs. Use the date that matches your child's grade and calendar.

customSections.label: Woodcrest Intersession Leads Into CCS Spring Break
customSections.content: Traditional students have a 30-minute early dismissal April 13 and Spring Break April 14–21. Woodcrest is already in intersession April 3–13 and then joins the districtwide Spring Break April 14–21. Together, the Woodcrest intersession and districtwide Spring Break keep Woodcrest students out of class from April 3 through April 21.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Columbus City Schools start in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: On the traditional calendar, grades 1–12 start Thursday, August 19, 2027, kindergarten starts Tuesday, August 24, and Pre-K starts Tuesday, September 7. Woodcrest grades 1–5 start July 22.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every Columbus City Schools student follow the traditional calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Most CCS students follow the traditional calendar, while Woodcrest uses a year-round calendar with a July start and intersessions. For 2027–28, CCS has not posted separate Pre-K PDFs; Pre-K dates appear on the published traditional and Woodcrest calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCS Wellness Week in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: All schools are closed Monday, November 22, through Friday, November 26, 2027. November 24 is the compensatory day for parent conferences within that closure.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCS Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 20, through Friday, December 31, 2027. Traditional classes resume Monday, January 3, while Woodcrest begins a separate January 3–7 intersession.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCS Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Traditional schools are closed April 14–21, 2028, and classes resume Monday, April 24. Woodcrest is also out for intersession April 3–13 immediately before that closure.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day for CCS students in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The traditional-calendar last day is Thursday, May 25, 2028. Woodcrest students finish Wednesday, May 31.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens for Pre-K on CCS early-dismissal days in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: On December 17, the traditional calendar says there is no Pre-K because of professional development while K–12 students dismiss 30 minutes early. On April 13, the traditional PDF lists a 30-minute early dismissal but does not mark a separate Pre-K closure.

calendarFaqs.q: Is there a separate CCS Pre-K PDF for 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar hub currently lists only the traditional and Woodcrest year-round PDFs for 2027–28. This page preserves the Pre-K dates shown on those PDFs but does not provide an unpublished Pre-K-specific download.
